name: CRF_AUDIT_HISTORY
description: Audit History Data Model for Claim Reference Data records.

columns.name: REF_DATA_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the Claim Reference Data record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: CHANGE_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The instant of the audit history event.

columns.name: CHANGE_USER_ID
columns.description: The ID of the user responsible for the record event logged in the Audit History.

columns.name: CHANGE_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: CHANGE_ACTION_C_NAME
columns.description: The action type of the event in the record Audit History.
entries: Set Items to Support 275 Claim Status Request
Set Items to Support 276 Claim Status Request

columns.name: CHANGE_ITEM
columns.description: The item changed in the event of the record Audit History.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_RAW_VALUE
columns.description: The previous raw value of the edited item in the record.

columns.name: NEW_RAW_VALUE
columns.description: The new raw value of the edited item in the record.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_CLAIM_ID
columns.description: The claim which was previously associated with the CRF record before the audit history event.

columns.name: NEW_CLAIM_ID
columns.description: The claim which is newly associated with the CRF record after the audit history event.

columns.name: NEW_ROI_ID
columns.description: The release record which was created using the CRF record during the audit history event.

columns.name: NEW_IS_CANCELLED_BY_PROV_C_NAME
columns.description: The new is cancelled flag which was updated during the audit history event.
